primary_source.title: Anomaly detection in time-series via inductive biases in the latent space of conditional normalizing flows
primary_source.claim_boundary: The paper motivates testing compliance with prescribed latent dynamics rather than observation likelihood. It does not establish performance for P1 or license replacing its conditional flow with a linear innovation proxy.

semantic_audit.reason: A faithful candidate requires a conditional normalizing flow plus prescribed state-space latent evolution and goodness-of-fit test. The proposed cheap causal approximation would reduce to the already closed P1 causal state-space innovation/latent-GP/Koopman family; retaining the nonlinear flow would be a materially larger deep generative architecture that is not safely fixed or supported inside this cycle's maximum-nine-fit contract.

next_axis: row-level prefix-supervised bipartite ranking loss over a fixed causal context basis, with add-only decoding and the unchanged multi-environment transport veto
